options.name: config
options.description: Specifies the vlan mapping related configurations.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the operation to be performed on the vlan mappings configured on the device. In case of merged, the input configuration will be merged with the existing vlan mappings on the device. In case of deleted, the existing vlan mapping configuration will be removed from the device. In case of overridden, all existing vlan mappings will be deleted and the specified input configuration will be add.
